label: TP
reason: User-controlled input from Referer header flows directly to HTML output without effective sanitization. URL decoding preserves XSS payloads (converts %3C to <), and substring truncation (removing last char) is not a reliable XSS prevention technique. Attacker can craft payloads that remain executable.

evidence.note: User input retrieved from Referer header
URL decode applied but does not sanitize XSS
Substring operation strips only last character, insufficient to block all XSS vectors
Unsanitized value written directly to HTML response
